Important Disclaimer: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme-related documents carefully before investing. Past performance is not an indicator of future returns. The NAV of the scheme may go up or down depending upon the factors and forces affecting the securities market. Standard Deviation is calculated using monthly rolling returns for last 3 years. Sharpe Ratio is calculated using risk-free rate of return (FIMMDA Overnight MIBOR) 6.98%. All data as on respective mentioned dates. An Investor Education Initiative by Edelweiss Mutual Fund.
